source.title: Duskwood Mission XIII: Defeat Ylanthrius
source.description: While these demons distract us here, the Emerald Dream is being corrupted into nightmare. Quick, travel through the Emerald Dream Portal in the Twilight Grove, and journey to the Nightmare Incursion at the Yorgen Farmstead. Defeat the dragon Ylanthrius there and return to me.
source.objective: Defeat Ylanthrius in the Duskwood Nightmare Incursion at the Yorgen Farmstead field and return to Field Captain Palandar.
source.completion: Well done! Your services shall be well rewarded. Perhaps another mission?
